summary: The comment supports maintaining the e-rate program for libraries and schools to ensure access and affordability.

claims.requested_action: Continue to fully fund the e-rate program for libraries and schools
claims.argument: Dismantling the program will make it difficult for libraries and schools to afford internet access
claims.evidence_quote: Dismantling this useful and effective program will make it difficult for libraries and schools, especially those in economic disadvantaged communities, to afford to offer internet access to patrons and students.
